lanes.verdict: There is something real here, but it is narrower than the lane brief implies. Most of the lane is graveyard-adjacent on arrival: month-end/turn-of-month flow is dead (slate 2), NDX annual reconstitution was formally cheap-killed (seq 479, N≤4 by construction) and slate 5's no-re-spec rule blocks reopening it without an owner waiver — even though the 20-year 1-min window would cure the N problem, so I flag it as waiver-eligible rather than propose it; expiration-adjacent flows collide with the killed post-expiration breakout; the opening-auction side is blocked by the gap-fade and ORB closures; ETF creation/redemption flows are unobservable on this substrate without degenerating into daily momentum. What survives is the close-anchored flow-pressure complex, and it is genuinely alive: the closing cross is the one market venue whose uninformed-flow share has structurally TRIPLED since 2010 (aggregate-level reversal evidence in Cushing-Madhavan 2000 and Bogousslavsky-Muravyev 2023), the repo's own DR pass A ranked exactly this mechanism (H6) and never tested it, and the post-cash-close 16:00-16:14 futures window has never been traded by any live engine or dead family. Both proposals are fade-shaped, and the six-fade graveyard is the single strongest prior against them — but every dead fade was price-structure-anchored at intraday 3-min horizons, and the complementarity precedent (slate-1 fades: losing-day corr −0.11) says the correlation gate will pass; after-cost expectancy at index-level netting is the honest binding risk for both. If the campaign wants to spend only one slate slot, CLOSEREV and EODREV can be merged into one preregistered close-pressure family with two frozen sub-specs, since they share a driver and differ in conditioning and holding period. Zero manufactured beyond these two.

There is one real engine-shaped idea in this lane and one cheap enabling study; the rest of the lane is honestly barren against this repo's kill list. The genuinely alive item is the state-dependence of liquidity-provision returns (Nagel RFS 2012; Campbell-Grossman-Wang QJE 1993): the six locally killed reversion families were all unconditional, intraday, structure-anchored, and 2022-26-only, while the literature's actual claim — and the repo's own recorded complementarity paradox (fades earning +$306/+$401 on champion bottom-decile days at corr -0.11) — is that reversal pays ONLY in high-stress states, at daily horizons, and our untouched 20-year 1-min history contains ~7 stress clusters the killed tests never saw; this is a falsifiable interaction claim with a built-in calm-state control, not a re-spec of a dead config, though it remains a member of a class the repo marks inference-dead and carries a material left-tail/decay failure probability. The tick/BBO question has a concrete answer: not as a signal (U2/U9B stand) but as a one-time fidelity certifier for 20-year OHLC liquidity proxies (EDGE/Corwin-Schultz/Abdi-Ranaldo), with the honest expectation that NQ's tick-pinned spread means the study may close negative — which is itself decision-relevant. Everything else scouted came up empty or collides: within-day index momentum and its LETF-rebalancing last-half-hour variant are foreclosed by MOM01's CLEAN_NULL plus the explicit lane exclusion; same-half-hour-of-day flow periodicity (Heston-Korajczyk-Sadka JF 2010, Bogousslavsky JF 2016) is cross-sectional equity with no published single-index-futures analog, so proposing it would be manufacturing; volume-clock/VPIN work predicts volatility, not returns, and is largely redundant with existing vol states (and weakened by the Andersen-Bondarenko critiques); auction-to-auction and RTH-open liquidity dynamics reduce, on this substrate, to the already-dead gap/overnight-drift/ORB/weekend-diffusion axes. Sources: Nagel Evaporating Liquidity (https://academic.oup.com/rfs/article-abstract/25/7/2005/1602153, https://www.nber.org/papers/w17653), CGW 1993 (https://academic.oup.com/qje/article-abstract/108/4/905/1899978), Heston-Korajczyk-Sadka 2010 (https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1111/j.1540-6261.2010.01573.x), Bogousslavsky 2016 (https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1111/jofi.12436), Corwin-Schultz 2012 (https://www.researchgate.net/publication/227374881), Abdi-Ranaldo 2017 (https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=2725981), Ardia-Guidotti-Kroencke EDGE JFE 2024 (https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0304405X24001399), short-term-reversal decay evidence (https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0378426622000309).

ZERO proposals — this lane is structurally barren on this substrate, and I can show it sub-topic by sub-topic rather than by taste. The governing constraint is that with only a linear instrument (NQ futures, no options, no VIX/variance futures), any "volatility engine" payoff must be expressed either as (i) directional exposure re-timed by a vol state, or (ii) option-like replication via breakout (long-gamma) or fade (short-gamma) structures — and every branch of that tree is already closed by repo evidence or literature. (1) Overnight-vs-intraday variance-split premia: the documented premium sits overnight (Lou-Polk-Skouras 2019 JFE tug-of-war; Boyarchenko et al. overnight drift), but locally the overnight-drift cheap-kill failed (t=1.00, COMPLEMENTARY_ENGINE_FRONTIER slate 1) and B1 overnight-inventory-premium is PARKED forward-gated and explicitly not proposable (research/scalping_lab/REJECTED_IDEAS.md line 27: +17.2t/night, CI [−17.0,+50.9] spans zero); a day-session-only vol-timed long has ≈zero raw premium to manage per the same literature. (2) Leverage-effect asymmetry as conditioning state: already tested here — LEV01 confirmed the market fact (t=−4.73, 5/5 years) but LEV02's strictly-causal trailing-regime version is a CLEAN NULL (runs/LEV01_VOLATILITY_ASYMMETRY, runs/LEV02_TRAILING_REGIME); re-proposing is an automatic collision. (3) Vol-jump follow-through vs mean-reversion at daily scale: continuation is SIGNIFICANTLY NEGATIVE locally (SMV2X shock-day, t=−2.22, N=12), the reversion side belongs to the six-family dead fade class, and E3-A's "penetration continues" fact establishes that any long-gamma-like replication merely duplicates Solar/B-MOM breakout fuel while short-gamma-like replication is the dead reversion class — both mirrors closed. (4) VRP proxied from realized measures: the premium is measurable (research/04_complementary_family/c01_t08_vrp_proxy_report.md already computed VIX−RV, short-VX, PUT proxies) but not harvestable on NQ-only — harvesting requires a vol-linear instrument (variance/VIX futures per the Cboe use case: https://cdn.cboe.com/resources/membership/Cboe-Variance-UseCases-CTA-Fund.pdf), VIX itself is options-derived (excluded data), Family E is registry-HOLD requiring a fresh prereg passing condition (b) at Bonferroni significance (0/3 passed), and all three proxies carry a 1.8–2.6× worst-decile overlap with the trend engines' best-decile days — a right-tail-gate red flag recorded before I arrived. (5) GARCH/HAR/vol-managed regime timing: statistical vol forecastability is real but its documented economic value flows only through re-timing a long premium (dead raw material here, per (1)) or down-weighting high-vol exposure, which repo evidence shows is tail-adverse for right-tail-concentrated engines (ARM_C vol-targeting retains only 49.4% of top-1% trade P&L, research/system_master/EVIDENCE_MAP_RAW.md line 382; INDICATOR_FEATURE_FRONTIER.md: "never down-weight high σ"); the real-time implementability of Moreira-Muir (2017 JF) vol management is independently refuted by Cederburg-O'Doherty-Wang-Yan (2020 JFE, 103 strategies, spanning-regression instability: https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0304405X2030132X), a caution the repo already imported in research/deep_research/DR-04.md. Adjacent states are also closed: SKEW01 killed causal return-skewness/semivariance-asymmetry (18/20 top winners excluded), R5+VOL-1 killed compression→expansion, M1/M5 killed vol-seasonal/ATR threshold forms. The standalone-vs-overlay distinction the lane brief demands does not rescue anything: standalone expression needs a premium or a vol-linear payoff, and neither exists on this substrate. Reopening conditions (both outside this lane's authority): acquisition of options/VIX/variance-futures data (GAMMA00 is DATA_LIMITED, purchase not authorized), or a fresh Family-E preregistration in the scalping campaign clearing its recorded significance gate. Proposing anything here today would be manufacturing; the value of this pass is the closure map above, which should prevent this lane from being re-opened by a future scout who has not read LEV02, SKEW01, SMV2X, ARM_C, and c01_t08.

Honest priors: TOM has the strongest literature and power but real decay/shift evidence and a B1-overnight-mask risk plus the slate's worst correlation-gate exposure; TERMFLOW has the cleanest mechanistic separation from every killed family (MOM01's all-days null becomes its control) but futures may price the flow before 15:50; QREBAL is the closest to a killed family and needs one free public data series, so it may die at adjudication. Investigated and dropped as barren: Treasury auction spillover (Lou-Yan-Zhang RFS 2013's 9-18 bps effect is documented in the Treasury secondary market only; the equity leg exists only as a surprise-reaction in Phillot AEJ:Macro 2025 — no predictable calendar pattern, fails the hypothesis-first bar), OPEX gamma-pinning (needs options data; repo's own pass flagged HIGH dedup vs killed value-area rotation), VIX settlement unwind (anecdotal-only grounding per the repo's own pass), and Russell reconstitution standalone (N=4-5). Realistic expectation: one of the three passing its frozen gates would be a good outcome; zero would not be surprising on a market that has killed 15/15 Engine-3 candidates.

Honest answer: Lane 5 is nearly barren, and most of its flashiest named ideas die against the repo's own record before literature even enters. Reasoned zeros: (1) asymmetric overnight foreign-session response — pre-litigated three ways: c01_t07 decomposed overnight NQ (unconditional ~0, t=0.76, upholding the NY Fed falsifier; the conditional post-down-day sleeve failed its gate with a crash-eating left tail), the NY Fed's own 2026 'Disappearing Overnight Drift' shows the Boyarchenko 2-3am European-open hour ≈0 since 2021, and B1 is parked-not-proposable — any hour-window or condition re-slice would be a re-tune of a closed mechanism; (2) intraday jump classification — bracketed on every side by killed families (10s spikes: no directional bias; daily 3-sigma shocks: significantly NEGATIVE continuation; post-macro-release: flat; release fade: parked as B-FADE) with no published index-level result strong enough to overcome that local gradient; (3) max-pain/gamma-pinning proxies without options data — the repo's own DR-02 already adjudicated bar-data gamma proxies as weak instruments whose null can't falsify anything, and post-expiration unclamp was tested and killed (seq 398): zero; (4) dispersion/correlation regime — fails the lane's standalone-expectancy bar by construction and its tradable form was killed as e410. What survives is two preregistered CHEAP KILLS, not conviction engines, and I say so plainly: EARN-CAL (rank 1) tests whether the mega-cap concentration era (2016-2026, untested in the literature in either direction — the 'disappearing premium' evidence ends exactly where the regime begins) left any index-level shadow of the documented earnings event-risk premium, using a weight-dose design and a genuinely new, free, exogenous data class (EDGAR 8-K calendar) whose infrastructure value survives a null — including the never-run audit of the incumbent's realized exposure through mega-cap earnings nights; PREHOL (rank 2) closes the last untested calendar cell with 20-year power against the historical effect size, where the best modern replication (Ko-Yang CFR 2024) predicts a null on a mega-cap index. Expected outcome on both is null; the value purchased is permanent closure of two named cells plus one reusable data class, at roughly two days of work and zero data cost. Nothing in this lane plausibly replaces Engine-3 hunting via genuinely new data (options/dealer positioning, accumulated tick history), and manufacturing a third proposal to look productive would have been worse than saying so.
